## Decision
The delivered result is an equilibrium-initialized storage theorem, NOT yet a reachable quantum memory. Under its literal resources, neither its endpoints nor an active fault-tolerant computer are supplied. Giving active fault tolerance unlimited resets while charging passive loading would be unfair; giving passive memory an exact interacting Gibbs state and instantaneous logical overwrite while charging active loading would be equally unfair.

The class includes V=0 and H_B0=0. Then the designated bath is not a cooling or reset device. Exact joint unitary evolution preserves the spectrum and cannot generally convert an arbitrary initialization into the target joint Gibbs state. No mixing rate follows from locality or stationarity. Taking a thermodynamic bath-volume limit does not fix this counterexample. More generally, reaching a nearby temperature globally is not enough unless its relevant logical/syndrome domination is controlled.

## Decisive established result
Chen–Galanis–Goldberg–Perkins–Stewart–Vigoda, *Fast algorithms at low temperatures via Markov chains*, arXiv1901.06653v6 (13 April2021), https://arxiv.org/pdf/1901.06653 . Definition1/Theorem2 uses precisely the proposed inequality sum_{eta incompatible gamma}|eta|w_eta ≤ theta|gamma| and gives single-polymer mixing O(N log(N/epsilon)). Definition3 demands membership and weight evaluation in poly(|gamma|). Definition4 strengthens small activity to w_gamma≤exp(−tau|gamma|), tau≥5+3log((q−1)Delta), on bounded-degree hosts with q labels. Theorem5 then gives sampling time O(N log(N/epsilon) log(1/epsilon)), without enumerating the full logarithmic-size dictionary. The host need not be a Euclidean lattice or an expander; those are applications, not general-theorem requirements. This is the credible cheaper alternative, conditional on the local algorithmic premises. Their real-weight computation model still needs an explicit finite-bit implementation charge.

## Mapping to the proposed operation (assessment)
Use marked objects as host vertices and stencil-overlap as edges. Trace components are connected labeled subsets; mutually compatible components have host distance at least two, matching the theorem's subset-polymer model. With N=O(n), fixed finite label alphabet, bounded host degree, and trace size m≤A|x_gamma|, the existing result applies at beta J_min/A at least its sampling threshold (after counting actual labels/degree).

This mapping does NOT establish any of the following for RX/RZ: a finite bounded-degree gate-level circuit, exact accepting-syndrome equivalence, unique splitting/recombination, uniform A, or local candidate validation. In particular, a global polynomial-time decoder does not imply poly(m)-time membership. If validating one small trace requires replaying an O(n)-size circuit, polynomial total sampling may remain possible with that extra charge, but the near-linear theorem cannot simply be quoted. A local certificate should check wire consistency, deterministic gate truth tables, rejecting flags and every boundary/fanout zero constraint using random-access local circuit data. # Positive backward-noise thermalization: targeted prior/comparator gate
2026-11-01. Scope: supplied encoded input; known independent terminal Pauli channels; target commuting H0 thermal encoding. Positive efficient sampling remains a construction obligation.

## Closest primary mechanism
van Enter–Fernández–den Hollander–Redig, *Possible loss and recovery of Gibbsianness during the stochastic evolution of Gibbs measures*, arXiv math-ph/0105001v1, 2May2001 (PDF also prints a later dateline), https://arxiv.org/pdf/math-ph/0105001 . Theorem4.1 proves short-time FORWARD preservation of Gibbsianness for finite-range initial interactions and dynamics. Its independent-flip proof §4 pp14–15 uses connected error islands with activity epsilon^|gamma| exp[H(sigma^gamma)−H(sigma)], an exponential absolute activity bound, and uniformly convergent logarithmic cluster expansions for local density ratios. The general setup is a lattice spin configuration space, with stated translation-invariant finite-range rates. This is not a theorem asserting positive inverse-noise preparation, nor an efficient sampler. Nevertheless it is a very close existing derivation, not merely a shared keyword. “Backward process” elsewhere in this work is conditional time reversal, not the linear inverse of the forward channel.

## What is routine and what is not (assessment, not theorem import)
For an involution T and C=(1−q)I+qT, C^{-1}=((1−q)I−qT)/(1−2q). For multiple commuting translations, applying the inverse to a Gibbs density yields an error-set sum with activity −q/(1−q), times a positive prefactor. Consequently the proposed signed-polymer zero-freeness argument is a short analytic-continuation adaptation of established error-island cluster machinery, provided the actual energy-difference factorization and uniform absolute bounds are earned. A real nonzero finite-volume partition sum connected continuously to its positive q=0 value stays positive. Normalization then follows algebraically from C preserving total mass. This inference is not the stated forward theorem.

Finite-volume continuity alone is insufficient: the allowed q could shrink with n. The substantive estimate is a size-independent disk of zero-freeness for EVERY syndrome and EVERY inverse prefix.
